hero.headline: Carpentry and handyman jobs done right in Shepparton.
hero.subhead: Carpentry, repairs, insulation, tiling and small renovations around the house. Send a few photos and get a clear written quote from Garry.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the GD Trading assistant. Got a carpentry job or something around the house that needs fixing? Tell me about it and I'll help you get a quote.

about.headline: One tradie for the jobs around your house.
about.body: Most homeowners want the same thing from a handyman: someone who turns up, works out the problem, does tidy work at a fair rate and is easy to deal with. Every job runs that way, big or small.

cards.title: Things that need fixing
cards.body: Problems looked at, a fix suggested, and the job sorted quickly.

cards.title: Small renovations
cards.body: Carpentry, tiling and insulation to change how a room or space works.

cards.title: Older houses
cards.body: Insulating walls and upgrading tired parts of an older home.

about.closing: Got a list of jobs? Send a few photos and Garry will take a look.

problems.headline: Finding a reliable handyman in Shepparton shouldn't be this hard.

points.title: Unreturned calls & slow quotes
points.body: Small jobs that nobody wants to call back about.

points.title: Vague pricing & surprise costs
points.body: No idea what it costs until the invoice turns up.

points.title: Missed timelines
points.body: A one-day job that drags on for weeks.

points.title: Messy job sites
points.body: Offcuts and dust left behind for you to clean up.

problems.bridge: You should get a fair quote and a tradie you'd happily call again.

services.title: Carpentry & repairs
services.body: Doors, frames and timber work, and those repairs that keep getting put off.

services.title: Insulation & small renovations
services.body: Wall insulation and carpentry for renovations, like moving a laundry or opening up a space.

services.title: Tiling
services.body: Floor and wall tiling done neatly as part of a job or on its own.

process.headline: We look at it. Quote it fairly. Do it right.

steps.title: Send your job
steps.body: Share a few photos with the form or give Garry a ring.

steps.title: Look & quote
steps.body: Garry checks the job, suggests the fix and sends a clear quote.

steps.title: Quality work
steps.body: Neat, careful work, with help sourcing materials at good prices.

steps.title: Clean-up & check
steps.body: Site left tidy, and a final look together.

themes.title: Fair rates
themes.body: Reasonable pricing, and help getting materials for less.

themes.title: Can-do attitude
themes.body: Problems worked out and fixed quickly.

themes.title: Repeat customers
themes.body: Locals who've called Garry back for more jobs.

realReviews.author: Graham Truran
realReviews.text: Insulated the walls of  our 30 year old house, carpentry and tiling to help us move the laundry out under the front verandah. Excellent work, very fair rates, helped us source materials at competitive prices.  Highly recommended

realReviews.author: Luciano
realReviews.text:
Couldn't recommend Garry highly enough for his work. Great communication and happy to complete work exactly to expectation. I was really happy with his application to the job, working like he was creating for himself. Neat, clean and professional work which I couldn't be happier with.
I'll be using Garry's services again, don't hesitate to give him a call. Thanks mate.

realReviews.author: Ken Baxter
realReviews.text: Garry visited to look at our issue and provided a suggestion to fix the problem and set to work to resolve this issue. He was very efficient, competent and confident in what he was doing. In a timely manner Garry rectified the problem to our great satisfaction. Garry’s positive can-do attitude made him a pleasure to deal with.

finalCta.headline: Got a job that needs doing?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos or pick a time for Garry to come out. You'll get a written quote before any work is booked.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. Repairs and small jobs are welcome, as well as bigger carpentry and renovation work.

faq.q: Can you help me source materials?
faq.a: Yes. Garry can help you find the right materials at competitive prices.

faq.q: What kind of work do you do?
faq.a: Carpentry, repairs, wall insulation, tiling and small renovations around the house.
Ask when you request your quote and we'll send the licence and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I send a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to Garry, you get a text and email confirmation, and he follows up to have a look at the job.
